Cardinal Health regulatory scrutiny drug distribution 2026

findings.claim: DOJ 於 2023-11 發出 CID，調查 2022 年收購 GPO 與風濕科 MSO 少數股權交易是否違反反回扣法與 False Claims Act；公司配合調查，屬非反壟斷事項。
findings.excerpt: In November 2023, we received a Civil Investigative Demand ("CID") from the Department of Justice focused on potential violations of the Anti-Kickback Statute and False Claims Act in connection with a 2022 transaction in which we purchased a minority ownership interest in a rheumatology managed services organization and a group purchasing organization. We are cooperating with this investigation.

findings.claim: 公司在反壟斷集體訴訟中是原告／集體成員，FY2026 認列淨回收 2,400 萬美元（FY2025 為 1.71 億），非被告。
findings.excerpt: We recognized income for net recoveries in class action antitrust lawsuits in which we were a class member or plaintiff of $24 million, $171 million, and $117 million during fiscal 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively.

findings.claim: 搜尋未見 2026 年針對 CAH 的新 DOJ／FTC 反壟斷調查或拆分報導；結果主要為 SEC 文件與舊案（2015–2018 FTC 放射藥房案）。
findings.source: WebSearch 彙整（SEC 文件、Mintz 2018 FTC 案）
